values./system/description:
Another dangerous meat to obtain, Yao Guai meat comes from the bodies of slain Yao Guai, a ferocious mutated form of bear that roams the wastelands. The meat is highly prized and nutritious, though still irradiated if consumed raw.

Yao Guai meat can be cooked to make Yao Guai Ribs or Yao Guai Roast.
